description: A static configuration that follows the active pointer.

input.scenario: The engine configuration lists the skills path as <root>/active/packages. An engine run started on gen-0041 rescans after the pointer moved to gen-0042.

expect.behaviour: Non-conforming: the run reads gen-0042 content (or a mix) although it started from gen-0041; a conforming host names gen-0041 in the projection.
